questions.question: Which of the following about Prometheus's punishment is true?
options: An eagle ate his heart only once.
He was chained to a rock in the west.
His liver kept growing back, and the eagle returned every day.
Zeus forgave him a year later.
questions.answer: His liver kept growing back, and the eagle returned every day.
questions.explanation: 課文寫 Though his liver kept growing back, the eagle would return every day to gnaw at it again。被啄的是肝（liver）不是心；地點在東方；課文說折磨會持續到 the end of time，沒有被原諒。

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Prometheus sacrificed himself to help humans and became known as their champion.
Zeus was the wisest of all the gods.
Humans learned to hunt wild beasts.
questions.answer: Prometheus sacrificed himself to help humans and became known as their champion.
questions.explanation: 全文以 Prometheus 為人類付出、受罰，最後獲得 "Champion of Humankind" 稱號為主軸。其餘選項是錯誤細節或與課文不符。
